# TextField

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:text-field` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

A labeled single-line input or multi-line textarea with hint and error text, an optional leading icon, clear button, and character count, at the 44px control height or compact.

## When to use

Collect free text (names, addresses, notes, comments) with Kerf's field chrome, a visible or accessible label, supporting and validation text, and native input semantics.

- A form or dialog collects a line of free text: label names it (or ariaLabel when nearby content already does), hint explains it, and error reports a validation problem.
- People write a longer note or message: multiline with rows, or rows plus maxRows to grow with the content; maxLength with showCount shows the remaining budget.
- A filter or search field needs a leading icon and a clear button: icon and clearable.

**Not when:**

- Do not use when only existing values are allowed; use Select.
- Do not use when people pick among suggestions or create tags; use Combobox.
- Do not use for search text with removable filter tokens; use SearchField.
- Do not use for a chat-style message with a send action; use MessageComposer.

**Alternatives:**

- [Input](./wa-input.md) (prefer-over)
- [Textarea](./wa-textarea.md) (prefer-over)
- [Combobox](./combobox.md) (nearest) — Use Combobox when people pick among suggestions or create a value.
- [MessageComposer](./message-composer.md) (nearest) — Use MessageComposer for a message with a send action.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/text-field` — exports `TextField`, `wireTextFields`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/text-field` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/text-field.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Wiring: `wireTextFields` from `@kerfjs/ui/wire-text-fields` (optional).
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/text-field`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuitext-field) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- visible label or ariaLabel
- hint
- error
- default or compact size
- leading icon
- clearable
- multiline (fixed rows or growing to maxRows)
- maxLength with a live count
- disabled
- read-only
- required
- email, password, search, url, tel, or number type

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md).

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** value; validation and error copy; hint copy; what a cleared field means.

**Wiring:** `wireTextFields` is optional.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Label, hint, and error sit on the value's text column (1px border + 8px padding); the 44px box matches Button and Select, and compact matches their compact 33px.

## Accessibility

- The whole field is a \<label> around a native \<input> or \<textarea>, so clicking anywhere on it focuses the field; the input is named by label (aria-label, with the visible label text hidden from assistive technology so the clear button and count stay out of the name) or by ariaLabel. Focus shows the standard focus ring around the box.
- The hint and error are visible below the field and form the input's aria-description; an error also sets aria-invalid="true". The clear button is a native button named by clearLabel (default Clear), hidden while the field is empty, and returns focus to the field.
- Compact text grows to 16px on coarse-pointer touch screens so iOS does not zoom on focus.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-text-field`, `kui-text-field__label`, `kui-text-field__required`, `kui-text-field__box`, `kui-text-field__icon`, `kui-text-field__input`, `kui-text-field__clear`, `kui-text-field__hint`, `kui-text-field__error`, `kui-text-field__footer`, `kui-text-field__count`.

Never put `kui-text-field`, `kui-text-field__label`, `kui-text-field__required`, `kui-text-field__box`, `kui-text-field__icon`, `kui-text-field__input`, `kui-text-field__clear`, `kui-text-field__hint`, `kui-text-field__error`, `kui-text-field__footer`, `kui-text-field__count` on an element you write; render `TextField` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-neutral-on-quiet`, `--kui-color-neutral-border-normal`, `--kui-color-danger-border-loud`, `--kui-color-danger-on-quiet`, `--kui-color-text`, `--kui-color-text-quiet`, `--kui-color-surface`, `--kui-focus-ring`, `--kui-font-m`, `--kui-font-s`, `--kui-font-xs`, `--kui-layout-item-padding`, `--kui-layout-rounded-radius`, `--kui-radius-circle`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
